Merit scholarships for school students

Each scheme below rewards good board exam results.

Santoor-style Scholarship for Girls

The scholarship is open to girls who passed Class 12 with a minimum of 60% marks.

Each selected student receives Rs. 24,000 per annum.

Central Sector-style Merit Scholarship

Students who have passed the Class XII Board Examination with at least 80% marks are eligible.

The scholarship pays Rs. 12,000 per annum.

Ishan Uday-style Class 11 Scholarship

Students studying in Class 11 who secured 75% in the Class 10 board examination may apply.

The scholarship pays Rs. 5,400 per annum.
